decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the firm's core map.apps platform, and its rapid releases show the firm can learn from feedback and improve it with its own R&D.
The hierarchical search bundle sits close to the established web-map offer, so the firm can readily interpret results and keep developing it, although its visibility is low.
The mobile layer control builds on existing map-control knowledge and was promoted on the home page, which suggests the firm intends to keep refining it.
As the flagship platform at the centre of the firm's strategic direction and expertise, it is very unlikely to be dropped.
Field data capture is close to the firm's GIS core and has a page of its own, so related knowledge and R&D support its continued development.
The search extension is close to the established offer and presented on a page of its own, so the firm can assimilate feedback and maintain it.
